title: ErrorResponse
description: Consistent error envelope returned across component boundaries (validation, dependency, timeout, missing information, internal). Any component may return this instead of its success contract.

error_id.description: Unique id for this error occurrence (UUID recommended).

task_id.description: Round/task id when the error occurred inside a round. Omitted if not yet known.

category.description: Machine-readable failure class consumers branch on.

source_component.description: Component that produced the error, e.g. '02_red_role'.

message.description: Human-readable summary. Must not leak secrets or raw model prompts.

details.description: Optional machine-readable specifics (e.g. failing field path, dependency name).

retryable.description: Whether the orchestrator may retry the same request. timeout/dependency are typically true; validation/missing_information are false.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 time the error was produced.
